The '''Chief of Starfighter Command''' was the title given to the leader of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]]' [[Galactic Alliance Starfighter Command|Starfighter Command]]. After the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], several Galactic Alliance [[Officer/Legends|officers]] had to be replaced, and by [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Merratt Jaxton]] had risen to this position.
